scope: A law-uniform fiberwise continuation of the exact shared-hub |t|^{-1} L2-operator gain through any nonzero yz puncture, even with a quadratic-plus-affine hub phase.
statement: For fixed nonzero alpha,beta,delta and every t>0 there exists a cap-one probability density p_t such that the punctured shared-hub operator has L2 norm at least sqrt(pi/(8 t |delta|)); hence no universal C t^{-1} bound survives for delta!=0. This does not refute QFORM; it forces product/difference averaging before a worst-fiber operator norm.
